note: Set A's 13 claims are all faithful: the ωφn and ζφ formulas, the Kp/Ki gain expressions, the negative damping from the generator-torque controller, and the negative ∂P/∂θ in Region 3 are correctly bound with supporting quotes. Set B covers the same ground plus a few extra facts (derivative gain neglected, generator torque drops with speed error, proportional term adds damping), but it is padded with heavy duplication (ζφ = 0.6–0.7 stated four times, ∂P/∂θ negative five times, Kp and Ki twice each) and several garbled, truncated quotes. B also mislabels ∂P/∂θ as sensitivity to 'rotor angle' rather than rotor-collective blade-pitch angle and attaches an invented 'baseline design' condition to the ζφ recommendation. The extra coverage in B does not offset its redundancy and misbindings, so A is the cleaner, more reliable set.
